name: Wasatch Cable
old_description: Communication is the fabric upon which our company was founded.
about:
Wasatch Cable & Design, LLC operates from Springville, Utah, with a design and support presence in nearby Orem. The company was founded on the principle that communication is the fabric of its business, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details beyond the LLC structure are not stated, and founder names are not provided in available materials.

The company provides end-to-end cable assembly services, from design optimization for manufacturability through production and testing. It runs domestic design, engineering, and support functions while leveraging Pacific-Rim manufacturing facilities for cost-effective turn-key production. Capabilities include custom molded assemblies with unique connectors and over-molded strain reliefs, mechanically assembled cables, wire harnesses, and smart cables incorporating PCBs or discrete components. Every assembly undergoes 100% testing and is warranted against defects, and the firm offers stocking and warehousing programs to secure on-time delivery.

Wasatch Cable serves OEMs across a broad range of sectors, including point-of-sale, automotive, military, transportation, networking, radar, medical, and industrial automation. Its design gallery references applications such as USB, OBD, coaxial/RF, armored cables, video display, and legacy serial interfaces (RS-232, RS-442, RS-449), as well as injection-molded cases and enclosures.

The company emphasizes responsive communication and rapid turnaround on quotations, first articles, and final delivery as its primary differentiators. It positions itself as a no-nonsense engineering and manufacturing partner that accelerates customers' time to market through domestic design expertise combined with offshore production efficiencies.
